about_effort: သွက်ဂွံဇမြော်ပတိုန် လိခ်မန် ပ္ဍဲလောက ဒေတ်ဂျေတ်ဒေဝ်ဂှ် အဲဇန်လဝ် အေန်ဂျေန် OCR သွက်ဂွံဗှ်လိခ်မန်ရ။ မဝ်ဒေဝ်လၟုဟ်ဝွံ စကာလဝ် MobileNetV3 + BiLSTM သွက်ဂွံဗှ်လိခ်မန် ညံင်ဂွံဂွံဂုဏ်ဖိုလ်ရ။

docs_hero_desc: Optical character recognition for printed Mon text. Recognition runs on your own device, in the browser or through the SDKs, and works offline once the model is downloaded.
docs_install_desc: Install the Python package from PyPI. A virtual environment keeps it separate from your other projects.
docs_impl_desc: Load the engine and read a scanned page from a local image.
docs_standards_desc: What helps recognition. The model reads printed text. Handwriting is out of scope, except Myanmar digits.
docs_standards_dpi_desc: Scan at 300 DPI or more. That is advice, not a measured threshold: what the recogniser reacts to is how tall each line of text is in pixels.
docs_standards_light_desc: Scans work best. The model was trained on rendered text only, so camera photographs are outside what it has seen. If you photograph a page, use even light and avoid glare.
docs_sdks_desc: Libraries for JavaScript, Python, Go and Rust. Each one downloads the same pinned model and runs it on your machine.
docs_cli_desc: Extract text from PDFs and images, one file or a whole directory, with monocr-cli.
docs_privacy_guarantee: Recognition runs on your device. Your images and the recognised text stay there unless you choose to share a correction or a contribution, which uploads what you submit. The privacy policy lists what is stored.
docs_license_desc: Released under the MIT License. You may use, modify and redistribute the code, including commercially, as long as the licence notice is kept.
report_sharing_desc: Recognition runs on your device. Sharing a correction is different: once you tick the consent box and share, the corrected text, its error type and the file you attached (or the original output, if you attached none) are uploaded to the MonOCR project for model training.
